purpose: Define executable cash entitlement and spendable-cash availability for already compiled ordinary USD cash distributions; chart factors alone do not define this ledger.
assumption: Pre-tax historical research cash-flow model, not verified broker posting.
rules: Only already admitted USD-per-listed-share cash events with reconciled ex, record and pay dates and no unresolved due-bill semantics qualify. Conflicting/complex events remain blocked.

At the effective ex-session open, accrue the declared gross distribution per share on long beneficial shares owned through funded trades or completed exercise decisions before that session; preserve receivables after later stock sale.

A receivable contributes to equity from entitlement but is not spendable; release it at the first captured regular trading-session open strictly after the agreed pay date. Never spend unposted receivables before this model release clock.

Apply the agreed fractional paper research convention pro rata. Record zero modeled tax withholding and no inferred broker-specific dividend fees; these are pre-tax research assumptions, not claims about actual account proceeds.
Retain original source records, dates, security identity, policy identity and both accrual/release cash-ledger events. No invented stock fills, external funding or changed option deliverables.
Require complete captured settlement/trading calendar coverage for the release clock; missing clocks remain unresolved.
authorization: User explicitly accepted the documented pre-tax cash-flow reconstruction model in this session.
